title: Prosecution seeks to fast-track testimonies of three witnesses in Duterte drug war case
summary: The International Criminal Court’s Office of the Prosecutor is seeking to formally introduce the prior recorded testimonies of three key witnesses in the case against Rodrigo Duterte.
